seoTitle: Schitt's Creek Test: Which Character Are You? (12 Questions)
metaDescription: Take the Schitt's Creek test: 12 everyday questions reveal whether you're Johnny, Moira, David, Alexis, Stevie, Patrick, Roland or Twyla. Get your full character breakdown.
intro: Are you the one with a business plan, the one with a wig for every mood, or the one rolling their eyes at the front desk? Answer 12 everyday questions about family, work and starting over, and find out which Schitt's Creek character you are.

characters.name: Johnny Rose
characters.title: The Dependable Dad
characters.summary: Responsible, earnest and endlessly hopeful. You believe hard work fixes most things, and you're usually the one holding everyone together.
description: Like Johnny, you built something from nothing. He founded Rose Video, a huge video-rental chain, and made his family very rich.

You don't stay down for long. When the family lost everything and had to move into a motel in Schitt's Creek, a town he'd once bought as a joke, Johnny started looking for the next opportunity straight away.
You're a business person at heart. Johnny went into partnership with Stevie and turned a run-down motel into the Rosebud Motel Group.
characters.flaw: You try to manage everyone's problems, whether they asked you to or not.
characters.signature: A sharp suit, a firm handshake and a very long sigh.
characters.clashReason: they'd hand you a business plan for your whole life

characters.name: Moira Rose
characters.title: The Grande Diva
characters.summary: Dramatic, glamorous and unforgettable. You never do anything by halves, least of all a sentence.
description: Like Moira, you were made for the spotlight. She was a soap opera star, famous for playing Dr. Cassandra Rutherford on Sunrise Bay.
Your vocabulary is a performance in itself. Moira never uses a short word when a long, obscure one will do, and she has a wig for every mood.
You're more capable than people expect. Moira joined the town council, directed the town's production of Cabaret and made a comeback in The Crows Have Eyes III: The Crowening.
characters.flaw: You turn every small setback into a full-scale drama.
characters.signature: A wall of wigs, a very long word and a black-and-white outfit.
characters.clashReason: they'd turn every small problem into a performance

characters.name: David Rose
characters.title: The Anxious Aesthete
characters.summary: Stylish, sharp and a little anxious. You have very high standards, very clear boundaries and a softer heart than you let on.
description: Like David, you have excellent taste and you know it. He lives in black-and-white designer knitwear and has a strong opinion on everything.
You worry. A lot. David is not an outdoors person, not a morning person and not a fan of surprises, and he'll tell you exactly why.
You built something you love. David opened Rose Apothecary, a shop full of local products, and married his business partner, Patrick.
characters.flaw: You panic first and calm down later.
characters.signature: A chunky black sweater, a scented candle and a very expressive face.
characters.clashReason: they'd have a meltdown over the smallest thing

characters.name: Alexis Rose
characters.title: The Globe-Trotting Socialite
characters.summary: Breezy, charming and braver than you look. You've had a lot of adventures, and you're finally working out who you are.
description: Like Alexis, you've lived a big life. She partied around the world and has a wild story from almost every country, some of them possibly true.
You surprised everyone, yourself included. Alexis went back to finish high school, took a college marketing course and started her own PR company.
You grew up. Alexis and Ted broke up so that neither of them would have to give up the career they'd worked for.
characters.flaw: You talk about yourself a lot, even when you're trying not to.
characters.signature: A tiny handbag, a little wave and a story about a yacht.
characters.clashReason: they'd turn every conversation back to themselves

characters.name: Stevie Budd
characters.title: The Deadpan Outsider
characters.summary: Dry, sarcastic and quietly talented. You don't think much of yourself, but everyone who knows you does.
description: Like Stevie, you've got a very dry sense of humour. She ran the front desk of the town motel, mostly by being unimpressed with everything, and inherited it from her great-aunt.
You don't give yourself enough credit. Stevie struggled with self-doubt, until she was cast as Sally Bowles in the town's production of Cabaret and stunned everyone.
You're the loyal friend nobody saw coming. Stevie became David's best friend and Johnny's business partner.
characters.flaw: You doubt yourself before anyone else gets the chance to.
characters.signature: A flannel shirt, a motel key and a perfectly timed eye-roll.
characters.clashReason: they'd roll their eyes at everything you say

characters.name: Patrick Brewer
characters.title: The Steady Romantic
characters.summary: Calm, organised and quietly romantic. You're the steady one, and you show love in small, thoughtful ways.
description: Like Patrick, you're the calm in the storm. He has a business degree, keeps the books straight and stays level-headed when everyone else panics.
You're more romantic than you look. Patrick sang an acoustic version of Tina Turner's 'The Best' to David at an open mic night.
You found yourself in your own time. Patrick came out after he met David, and it changed his life.
characters.flaw: You keep things so tidy, even your feelings, that people can't tell what you're thinking.
characters.signature: A button-down shirt, a baseball glove and a very neat spreadsheet.
characters.clashReason: they'd quietly reorganise your plans into something sensible

characters.name: Roland Schitt
characters.title: The Mayor Without Boundaries
characters.summary: Loud, friendly and completely oblivious. You're everyone's neighbour, whether they want one or not.
description: Like Roland, you make yourself at home anywhere. The mayor of Schitt's Creek turns up unannounced, stays too long and never notices he's doing it.
You're proud of where you come from. Roland's family founded the town, and he's the latest Schitt to run it.
Underneath it all, you've got a good heart. Roland became Johnny's friend and partner in the Rosebud Motel Group, and he's devoted to his wife, Jocelyn.
characters.flaw: You never notice when you've overstayed your welcome.
characters.signature: A loud laugh, a hand on your shoulder and a visit nobody planned for.
characters.clashReason: they'd turn up at your door without warning

characters.name: Twyla Sands
characters.title: The Eternal Optimist
characters.summary: Sunny, kind and much deeper than people think. You see the good in everyone, whatever you've been through.
description: Like Twyla, you're a ray of sunshine. She's the cheerful waitress at the town café, and she's always happy to see you.
You've been through a lot, and you'd never guess it. Twyla casually shares the most alarming stories about her family as if they're completely normal.
You're full of surprises. Twyla secretly won the lottery years ago, kept working at the café anyway, and finally bought it.
characters.flaw: You're so determined to see the bright side that you ignore when something's genuinely wrong.
characters.signature: An apron, a big smile and a family story nobody was ready for.
characters.clashReason: they'd be cheerful at you when you just want to be grumpy

questions.text: A friend invites you to a small-town fundraiser with a bake sale and a talent show. You...

options.text: Sign up for the talent show. You've been waiting for a stage
Bake something for the sale and cheer for every single act
Make an excuse and stay home. You'll hear all about it tomorrow
End up helping run it, with a microphone in your hand

questions.text: Your car breaks down on a quiet country road. You...

options.text: Pop the bonnet and stare at the engine with total confidence
Look on the bright side. It's a lovely day for a walk
Put your feet up and wait for someone to come along
Walk to the nearest farm. You probably know whoever lives there

questions.text: You want to show someone you love them. You...

options.text: Plan something small and personal that proves you really listen
Book a proper dinner and make a toast
Write them a very long, very dramatic letter
Blurt it out, then panic about how it sounded

questions.text: Your plans fall through and you suddenly have the whole afternoon free. You...

options.text: Find somewhere sunny and text around to see who's free
Get back into bed with bad TV and snacks. Perfect
Pop round to a neighbour's for a chat. Unannounced
Catch up on paperwork. Honestly, it's relaxing

questions.text: Someone gives you blunt feedback on something you made. You...

options.text: Take it on board calmly, and fix it
Get very defensive, then quietly make every change
Treat it as an attack on your artistry
Shrug it off. You're already over it

questions.text: At a party, someone asks you to tell them about yourself. You...

options.text: Tell a wild travel story that may be slightly exaggerated
Keep it short and turn the question back on them
Talk about your work, in more detail than they asked for
Overshare about your family within two minutes

questions.text: Someone keeps standing far too close to you and never takes the hint. You...

options.text: Tell them, clearly and a little awkwardly, where the line is
Stay polite, then sigh very deeply once they leave
Don't notice. It's probably you doing it
Deliver a withering remark they won't understand until later

questions.text: Friends invite you on a camping weekend. You...

options.text: Say no. Why would anyone sleep outside on purpose?
Love it. Campfire, cold drinks and a game of catch
Go for the photos, then leave early
Bring the tent, a guitar and the same campfire story every night

questions.text: You've got a talent most people don't know about. It's...

options.text: A singing voice that would surprise everyone
Being brilliant with spreadsheets and budgets
Talking your way into, or out of, almost anything
Giving a pep talk that gets any room back on its feet

questions.text: Your town is putting on a musical, and you're offered the lead. You...

options.text: Say no three times, then do it and stun everyone
Accept, and start giving the director notes
Agree before they've finished asking. How hard can it be?
Turn it down, and cheer from the front row instead

questions.text: Imagine you lose almost all your money overnight and have to move to a tiny town you'd never heard of. In the first week you...

options.text: Make a plan and start looking for a business opportunity
Refuse to unpack. This is temporary
Complain nonstop, then quietly start making the place nicer
Befriend half the town by Friday

questions.text: Imagine it's your wedding day. It's pouring with rain, the venue is flooding and the person running the ceremony has cancelled. You...

options.text: Stay calm. You're marrying the right person, the rest is details
Have a small breakdown, then realise the people are what matter
Offer to run the ceremony yourself. It needs some flair anyway
Cheer everyone up. Rain on your wedding day is good luck
